description: Codex CLI lifecycle hooks for the Compy repo. Codex hooks are a Stable, default-ON system (codex-rs Feature::CodexHooks) whose HooksFile parser uses deny_unknown_fields — so ONLY the two documented top-level keys `description` and `hooks` may appear (any comment/extra key rejects the whole file). Structure per the Codex contract: hooks.<EventName>[].matcher (regex over the Codex tool name) + .hooks[] with type:"command" (the ONLY executed type), command (POSIX shell) and commandWindows (native cmd.exe — used verbatim on Windows). Both commands resolve the repo root via `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` so they work from ANY session CWD (Codex does not guarantee CWD == workspace root), with no hardcoded workstation path. LANE: this repo runs Codex as a READ-ONLY advisor (AGENTS.md lane split). The single retained hook only INJECTS an advisory additionalContext string; it does not mutate the repository, Compy, or Windows state (its only side effect is a throttle marker under %TEMP%), and never authorizes install/ship/delete/commit. The Claude-lane automation (stop-continue, ship-reminder, subagent model/throttle guards, context-size advisor) was removed 2026-07-20 as not-Codex-native and/or not-read-only. ACTIVATION: a green hooks-selftest exercises these scripts' own logic and this file's schema; it does NOT prove Codex activates them in-product — only a trusted Codex runtime run proves in-product activation.

hooks.commandWindows: for /f "usebackq delims=" %r in (`git rev-parse --show-toplevel`) do node "%r/.codex/hooks/self-review-reminder.mjs"
